design: All312 frozenH944 full/rank1 relay jobs. At layer4 selected position separately add raw input delta to residual output, exact MLP finite delta, or both. Student MLP deltas replace exact delta with native MLP baseline retained; test with/without residual delta. Downstream model fully live. Not native MLP replacement.
metrics: Compare student effect to exact matching path, full distribution KL; quantify residual/MLP/joint effects and downstream nonadditivity. Identity and full/rank1 historical margin replay. All seeds/cells; no fitting or task selection.
